const accessorSource = { set value(next: number) {} };
const spread = { ...accessorSource };
const { ...rest } = accessorSource;
const wrongSpread: number = spread.value;
const wrongRest: number = rest.value;
spread.value = 1;
rest.value = 2;
const receiver = {
  set value(next: number) {},
  spread() { return { ...this }; },
  rest() { const { ...rest } = this; return rest; },
};
const wrongSpreadReceiver: number = receiver.spread().value;
const wrongRestReceiver: number = receiver.rest().value;
